'''Inijic''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan, or [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]] was a notable member of this clan.

==Behind the scenes==
While the Inijic kajidic itself has never been mentioned, its existence is implied by the name of Kossak Inijic Ar'durv. According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', the [[cuirvas]] (or middle name) of a Hutt identified their clan.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>
